item.title: Co. Monaghan actor receives iconic award
item.description: A Co. Monaghan actor and comedian has received UCD Literary and Historical Society's James Joyce Award. Ardal O'Hanlon received the award in recognition of his outstanding contribution to the ars and Irish cultural life. The Carrickmacross man's career has spanned more than three decades across television, film, stand-up comedy and literature. item.description: A man who was allegedly seriously assaulted in Monaghan town last January has died. It’s understood Declan Wallace was found dead at his home in Ballybay yesterday morning. The Castleblayney native who was aged in his 40s was left in a coma following the aftermath of an alleged serious assault on him on the North Rd in Monaghan 13 months ago. item.title: Road reopens following Cavan hit-and-run
item.description: A road in Co Cavan has reopened this evening following a hit and run incident. Gardaí and emergency services attended the scene of a hit-and-run single-vehicle crash that occurred on L1513 Drumlark, Loreto Wood, in Cavan yesterday. The crash involving a vehicle and a pedestrian occurred shortly after 6.45pm. Advertisement The female pedestrian, aged in her 20s was injured and taken to hospital for treatment for non life-threatening injuries. The male driver of the vehicle left the scene on foot.
